VTS Scoring Log

Behemoth Labz

US-based vendor · Founded 2014· Scored August 2026· behemothlabz.com

Behemoth Labz was founded in 2014 and is primarily known as a SARM vendor, with peptides occupying a meaningful but secondary position in its catalog. Colmaric Analyticals is named as the third-party testing lab. Batch numbers appear on product labels and correspond to COAs in the third-party analysis section of each product page. A 30-day money-back guarantee is documented. The decade-plus operational track record is the vendor's strongest VTS signal; the secondary-catalog status of peptides limits independent confirmation of testing depth.

75 /100
Moderate Transparency
Colmaric Analyticals named as testing lab, batch numbers on labels matched to product-page COAs, founded 2014. Peptides are secondary to SARMs in catalog focus.
Dimension Scores
Dimension Max Notes Score
Third-Party Testing Practice 30 Third-party testing via Colmaric Analyticals (named US lab). Every batch sent to an independent lab for contaminants, impurities, and purity. Peptides are a secondary catalog behind SARMs; full per-batch coverage of the complete peptide range is not independently confirmed with the specificity of peptide-first vendors. 22/30
Batch Traceability & Verification 20 Batch number visible on product label. Corresponding COA accessible in the third-party analysis section of each product listing. Lot-to-vial linking documented. No public portal linking directly to Colmaric's own database for independent verification. 13/20
COA Accessibility 15 COAs accessible on product pages in the third-party analysis section. Dedicated COA page exists at behemothlabz.com/certificate-of-analysis. Publicly accessible before purchase. 12/15
COA Completeness 15 Testing covers purity, identity, and concentration. Potency audits on liquid products (concentration within 10% of label). Contaminant screening documented. Chromatogram and full methodology detail not consistently confirmed from public sources reviewed. 12/15
Testing Recency 10 Batch-specific COAs with lot correspondence. No systematically stale results found. Recency for the peptide-specific catalog not independently confirmed with the same depth as for the SARM catalog. 8/10
Policy Transparency 5 30-day money-back guarantee documented in multiple review sources. US distribution center in Texas. Specific reship/refund language not confirmed from primary site during review. 3/5
Operational Track Record 5 Founded 2014. Over a decade of operation. US distribution center in Texas. Established brand with broad community recognition. Among the longest track records on the current VTS roster. 5/5

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Third-party community testing results documented via Colmaric Analyticals across several years for SARM products. Peptide-specific community test submissions are less frequent given the secondary catalog status. COAs often over 99% purity noted in independent reviews.
Community Experience
Mixed community feedback documented across review sources. Positive signals include reliable fulfillment and product consistency on core SARMs. Some complaints about business practices noted in multiple independent reviews. Buyers should consult current forum discussion.
Scoring Notes
Named testing lab: Colmaric Analyticals
Colmaric Analyticals is named consistently in independent review sources as the third-party testing lab. Colmaric is a known lab in the research community and its name appearing in multiple independent review sources adds credibility relative to unnamed testing claims.
Primary business is SARMs - peptide catalog is secondary
Behemoth Labz built its testing infrastructure primarily for its SARM catalog. This infrastructure likely transfers to peptides, but independent confirmation of per-batch testing depth across the full peptide range was not found in public materials reviewed. Peptide-focused buyers should request a specific compound COA before purchasing.
Community feedback captured in signal, not score
Mixed customer experiences are noted in the Community Signal section. The process-transparency score reflects verifiable documentation inputs only.
